reference_reason: Routine quarterly security and critical runtime updates.

title: AWS Copilot adds support for full customization with AWS CDK or YAML overrides
initial_reason: Copilot allows CDK and YAML overrides of generated infrastructure.
reference_reason: Adds property overrides to existing Copilot resource provisioning.

title: AWS Marketplace introduces new self-service listing feature for single AMI products
initial_reason: Marketplace adds self-service AMI publication workflow without manual processing.
reference_reason: Introduces self-service listing creation and updates replacing manually processed requests.

title: Amazon Connect now supports audio optimization for Citrix cloud desktops
initial_reason: Connect audio optimization adds Citrix desktop support.
reference_reason: Optimizes existing Connect audio for Citrix desktop environments.

title: Amazon SNS message data protection is now generally available with real-time data redaction and masking
initial_reason: SNS GA adds redaction and masking actions to message protection policies.
reference_reason: Explicit GA delta adds real-time payload redaction and masking operations.

title: Preview: Amazon Q Business now supports an integration with Smartsheet
initial_reason: Q Business adds Smartsheet data connector.
reference_reason: Q Business adds Smartsheet to its existing set of index synchronization connectors.

title: Amazon Redshift extends SQL capabilities to simplify and speed up data warehouse migrations (preview)
initial_reason: Redshift extends SQL compatibility and supported ingestion size.
reference_reason: Redshift adds SQL MERGE and multidimensional aggregation operations including CUBE and ROLLUP; these outweigh the accompanying size-limit increase.

title: Amazon EMR Serverless is now available in 4 new AWS Regions
initial_reason: EMR Serverless regional expansion.
reference_reason: Existing EMR Serverless expands to four regions.

title: AWS Glue Crawlers now support integration with Lake Formation
initial_reason: Glue crawlers use Lake Formation permissions for existing data-lake access.
reference_reason: Adds Lake Formation as the authorization method for existing crawler data access.

title: AWS announces geolocation enrichment for Amazon Fraud Detector Models
initial_reason: Adds geographic-distance enrichment to existing fraud model inputs.
reference_reason: Extends existing model enrichment with calculated geographical distance inputs.

title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB Compatibility) Global Clusters introduces Failover
initial_reason: Adds managed unplanned global failover operation retaining cluster configuration.
reference_reason: DocumentDB adds managed unplanned global failover preserving cluster topology, distinct from its existing planned switchover operation.

title: Anthropic's Claude 3.5 Sonnet model now available in Amazon Bedrock
initial_reason: Adds Claude 3.5 Sonnet to Bedrock model catalog.
reference_reason: Adds a newer foundation model to the Bedrock catalog.

title: AWS HealthImaging supports cross account data imports
initial_reason: HealthImaging imports extend across accounts and regions.
reference_reason: HealthImaging extends its existing DICOM import operation to S3 buckets in other accounts and regions.

title: AWS Migration Hub Orchestrator now supports Microsoft SQL Server transaction logs
initial_reason: Migration Hub Orchestrator adds SQL Server transaction-log backup option.
reference_reason: Adds transaction logs as a backup input option to existing migration workflows.

title: Amazon SNS now supports in-place message archiving and replay for FIFO topics
initial_reason: SNS FIFO adds in-place message archive and selective replay operations.
reference_reason: Introduces native message archiving and replay operations for SNS FIFO topics.

title: AWS re:Post streamlines customers’ community engagement with AWS Builder ID and re:Post Linked logins
initial_reason: Re:Post gains Builder ID authentication and linked-profile controls.
reference_reason: Adds another sign-in provider and linked login options to existing community profiles.

title: Amazon CloudWatch Synthetics supports canary events with Amazon EventBridge
initial_reason: Introduces EventBridge canary event publication for automated responses.
reference_reason: Introduces canary event emission to EventBridge for downstream actions.

title: Amazon Genomics CLI is now Generally Available
initial_reason: Introduces genomics CLI deployment and execution interface; no separate service positioning.
reference_reason: Introduces a genomics command-line workflow provisioning interface at launch.

title: Announcing generative AI upgrades for Apache Spark in AWS Glue (preview)
initial_reason: Glue introduces automated AI Spark upgrade operation
reference_reason: Adds automatic Spark code upgrade planning, rewriting and validation.

title: AWS Amplify announces the ability to add custom AWS resources to Amplify-created backends using CDK and CloudFormation
initial_reason: Introduces custom-resource extension command beyond built-in Amplify categories.
reference_reason: Extends existing backend resource provisioning to custom resources via CDK or CloudFormation.

title: QuickSight now provides standardized user level cost and usage data
initial_reason: QuickSight billing reports gain standardized user-level costs and usage.
reference_reason: Adds standardized per-user detail to existing cost and usage reporting.

title: Now use AWS Systems Manager Change Calendar to prevent desired-state updates during critical events
initial_reason: Applies existing Change Calendar gates to State Manager updates.
reference_reason: Adds calendar-based blocking controls to existing desired-state enforcement.

title: Amazon Time Sync Service now supports microsecond-accurate time
initial_reason: Time Sync adds PTP hardware-clock access alongside improved NTP precision.
reference_reason: Time Sync adds configurable PTP hardware-clock support and clock-accuracy auditing alongside automatic NTP accuracy improvements.

title: AWS Direct Connect expands AWS Transit Gateway support at more connection speeds
initial_reason: Direct Connect extends Transit Gateway connectivity to lower-bandwidth connections.
reference_reason: Extends existing Transit Gateway connectivity to lower-speed connection options.

title: AWS Well-Architected Tool now available in AWS GovCloud (US) Regions
initial_reason: Well-Architected Tool expands to GovCloud only.
reference_reason: Existing Well-Architected Tool expands to GovCloud.

title: Amazon Connect launches API to make an agent eligible for new contacts, after a missed contact
initial_reason: Connect gains programmable agent-notification clearing operation.
reference_reason: Introduces a programmatic interface for clearing missed-contact notifications.

title: AWS Console Mobile Application adds support for Asia Pacific (Osaka) region
initial_reason: Mobile console expands support to Osaka region.
reference_reason: Mobile console expands to Osaka region.

title: Meta Llama 3.1 405B now generally available in Amazon Bedrock
initial_reason: Bedrock adds Llama 3.1 405B model.
reference_reason: Adds another foundation model size to the Bedrock model catalog.

title: Amazon ECR supports Open Container Initiative Image and Distribution specification version 1.1
initial_reason: ECR supports OCI 1.1 reference artifact types.
reference_reason: Extends artifact management with OCI reference relationships and lifecycle handling.

title: Amazon Connect launches AWS CloudFormation support for users, user hierarchy groups, and hours of operation
initial_reason: Adds three Connect resource types to CloudFormation support.
reference_reason: Adds three resource targets to existing CloudFormation integration.

title: Amazon EC2 C7gn metal instance is now available
initial_reason: EC2 adds C7gn bare-metal size.
reference_reason: EC2 adds a bare-metal size of the existing C7gn family with specified capacity and networking characteristics.

title: AWS Amplify announces general availability of In-app messaging notifications for React and React Native
initial_reason: Amplify in-app messaging GA supplies no substantive GA delta.
reference_reason: Amplify announces in-app messaging GA and describes campaign and UI features without specifying changes from its prior release stage.

title: Amazon Lex launches support for Portuguese, Brazilian Portuguese, and Mandarin Chinese
initial_reason: Adds Portuguese and Mandarin languages to Lex.
reference_reason: Adds language compatibility to existing conversational processing.

title: AWS IoT Device Management launches Job Templates in Preview to make deployment of fleet-wide remote operations faster, easier, and more secure
initial_reason: Adds reusable templates for existing remote-job deployment operations.
reference_reason: IoT Device Management adds reusable templates and access controls for existing remote job actions and their deployment parameters.

title: Amazon RDS now supports io2 Block Express for consistent sub-millisecond latency and 99.999% durability
initial_reason: RDS adds io2 Block Express storage option.
reference_reason: Adds a higher-performance storage volume option to existing RDS storage provisioning.

title: AWS Backup supports cross-Region backups in four new Regions
initial_reason: Cross-Region backup expands to four Regions.
reference_reason: Existing cross-region backup feature expands to four regions.

title: Amazon SageMaker Inference Recommender improves usability and launches new features
initial_reason: Inference Recommender adds existing endpoint targets VPC options and diagnostic metrics.
reference_reason: Extends existing inference testing with existing-endpoint targets, controls and SDK support.

title: AWS Gateway Load Balancer launches new option to rebalance flows when target fails or deregisters
initial_reason: Gateway Load Balancer adds flow-rebalancing behavior control.
reference_reason: Adds a flow rebalancing configuration option to existing gateway load balancing.

title: Amazon SageMaker Edge Manager now integrates with AWS IoT Greengrass to simplify deployment to fleets of edge devices
initial_reason: First Greengrass integration introduces managed fleet deployment for Edge Manager packages.
reference_reason: Introduces managed Edge Manager agent and model deployment through Greengrass components.

title: AWS Lake Formation is now available in AWS Europe (Zurich) Region
initial_reason: Lake Formation expands to Zurich.
reference_reason: Lake Formation expands to Zurich; the body only explains established data-lake capabilities.

title: Amazon Location Service adds bounding box search for device positions
initial_reason: Location device search adds geographical bounding-box filter.
reference_reason: Adds a bounding-polygon filter to existing tracked-device position queries.

title: Amazon Redshift announces integration with AWS Glue column-level statistics
initial_reason: Redshift query optimization now consumes Glue column statistics.
reference_reason: Extends existing Glue catalog integration with statistics for query optimization.

title: Announcing product lifecycle support for AWS Supply Chain Demand Planning
initial_reason: Supply Chain adds product introduction and retirement forecasting parameters.
reference_reason: Adds product lifecycle dates and initial-value controls to existing demand forecasting.

title: Centrally manage root access in AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)
initial_reason: Adds centralized root credential removal and scoped temporary privileged sessions.
reference_reason: IAM adds centralized removal of member-account root credentials and scoped privileged operations using temporary credentials.

title: Amazon EFS Replication is now available in all AWS Regions
initial_reason: EFS Replication expands to remaining supported regions.
reference_reason: Existing EFS replication expands to remaining regions.

title: Announcing the Access Console for NICE DCV
initial_reason: NICE DCV adds web console for session lifecycle management.
reference_reason: Introduces a web console interface for existing session management APIs.

title: Announcing CloudFormation support for AWS Parallel Computing Service
initial_reason: Adds CloudFormation compatibility for PCS resource management.
reference_reason: CloudFormation gains PCS resource support for creating and managing existing cluster resources through infrastructure templates.

title: Amazon Connect now enables long lasting, persistent chat experiences
initial_reason: Connect chat creation can resume previous conversation context.
reference_reason: Adds previous-contact context carryover to existing chat creation.

title: AWS Step Functions adds support for over 200 AWS Services with AWS SDK Integration
initial_reason: Introduces generic AWS SDK invocation interface expanding beyond dedicated integrations.
reference_reason: Step Functions gains a general AWS SDK invocation interface spanning service API actions, beyond the previous curated service integrations.

title: Amazon Kinesis Video Streams improves image sampling frequency to 5 frames per second
initial_reason: Kinesis Video increases image sampling frequency to five frames per second.
reference_reason: Raises existing image extraction sampling frequency.

title: Amazon Connect now allows contact center managers to join ongoing calls
initial_reason: Connect introduces manager barge-in operation for ongoing calls.
reference_reason: Adds manager participation in live calls through barge-in.

title: AWS announces availability of Microsoft Windows Server 2025 images on Amazon EC2
initial_reason: EC2 adds Windows Server 2025 images
reference_reason: Adds Windows Server 2025 images to the existing EC2 operating-system catalog.

title: Amazon SNS now supports sending SMS from Asia Pacific (Jakarta)
initial_reason: SNS SMS Jakarta rollout.
reference_reason: Existing SNS SMS sending expands to Jakarta.

title: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) Performance Insights is now in preview
initial_reason: DocumentDB introduces database-load diagnostics through Performance Insights.
reference_reason: Introduces database performance diagnosis and bottleneck visualization.

title: Amazon Neptune announces support for SPARQL 1.1 Graph Store HTTP Protocol
initial_reason: Adds Graph Store protocol compatibility for existing graph manipulation.
reference_reason: Neptune GSP adds whole-named-graph variants of existing fetch, insert and delete operations; the source explicitly contrasts these with multiple existing SPARQL queries.

title: Announcing the general availability of AWS Wickr
initial_reason: Wickr GA identifies service capability but no clear substantive pre-GA delta.
reference_reason: AWS Wickr was already announced in preview on 2022-07-26; the GA source does not identify a substantive product delta.

title: Amazon FinSpace with Managed kdb Insights now supports running multiple kdb processes on shared compute
initial_reason: FinSpace permits multiple kdb clusters sharing provisioned compute through scaling groups.
reference_reason: FinSpace Scaling Groups allow multiple existing kdb clusters to share provisioned compute, adding a placement and utilization option.

title: Amazon CloudWatch adds Elemental MediaTailor to Vended Logs pricing
initial_reason: MediaTailor logs receive volume-discount pricing only.
reference_reason: Changes MediaTailor log pricing to volume-based vended-log tiers.
